title: Government scheme navigator
note: PLACEHOLDER CORPUS. Written to exercise the grounded-agent pattern, not to be relied on. Replace every entry with curated, sourced data before this module is shown to real users. The agent answers only from this file, so anything missing here is correctly refused.
sources: INTENTIONALLY EMPTY — scheme records must be curated from official sources before use

entries.content: No verified scheme records have been loaded into this module yet. Scheme names, eligibility rules, benefit amounts, deadlines and document lists must come from official sources and be reviewed before they appear here. Until that data is added, this module cannot answer questions about specific schemes and must say so.
The national scheme directory is myScheme (myscheme.gov.in). A Common Service Centre (CSC) or the relevant department office can confirm eligibility and the current document list in person.

entries.topic: About the scheme records in this file
entries.content: The schemes listed in this file are SAMPLE records with generic names. They do not describe any real government programme and their eligibility rules are illustrative. Do not quote them as fact. Replace them with verified records from official sources before this module is used.

name.en: Sample scheme A — vendor working-capital loan
name.hi: नमूना योजना A — विक्रेता कार्यशील पूँजी ऋण

summary.en: A small collateral-free working-capital loan for street vendors with a vending certificate.
summary.hi: वेंडिंग प्रमाणपत्र रखने वाले रेहड़ी-पटरी विक्रेताओं के लिए बिना गारंटी छोटा कार्यशील पूँजी ऋण।

name.en: Sample scheme B — artisan toolkit grant
name.hi: नमूना योजना B — कारीगर औज़ार अनुदान

summary.en: A one-time grant toward tools for registered artisans and home producers.
summary.hi: पंजीकृत कारीगरों और घरेलू उत्पादकों के लिए औज़ारों हेतु एकमुश्त अनुदान।

name.en: Sample scheme C — women's micro-enterprise support
name.hi: नमूना योजना C — महिला सूक्ष्म उद्यम सहायता

summary.en: Interest subsidy for micro-enterprises run by women.
summary.hi: महिलाओं द्वारा चलाए जा रहे सूक्ष्म उद्यमों के लिए ब्याज सब्सिडी।
